title: Jesus Seeks the Desperate
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about the God who is alive and active in the world, seeking out those with desperate hearts that are hungry and thirsty for Him. This sermon explores the stories of two individuals who were healed by Jesus, and how their faith and desperation led to a profound encounter with the King of Kings. Discover how you can experience the life-changing power of God's presence in your own life and become a part of the extraordinary life He has for you.
